trigger.description: The daemon accepts a connection but fails to install the per-connection read/write deadline via setsockopt(SO_RCVTIMEO / SO_SNDTIMEO) — e.g. under memory pressure, a seccomp filter that blocks setsockopt, or certain BSD kernel modes. handle_connection refuses the connection with a framed daemon_setsockopt_failed envelope and drops it rather than entering a deadline-less read that would pin the worker thread forever. The pre-bd-3pnno code discarded the setsockopt result with `let _ =`, leaving the permanent-worker-hang path.
trigger.invocation: Internal — handle_connection setsockopt failure path; not directly reproducible without injecting a setsockopt failure at the OS layer.

message_contains: daemon could not set the connection
